title: Impact of N-Terminal Domain Conformation and Domain Interactions on RfaH Fold Switching.
one_liner_zh: 该文用基于物理的全原子模型模拟RfaH蛋白的域解离与折叠转换，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-核酸互作（RNAP结合）及构象动态机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: RfaH is a two-domain metamorphic protein involved in transcription regulation and translation initiation. To carry out its dual functions, RfaH relies on two coupled structural changes: Domain dissociation and fold switching. In the free state, the C-terminal domain (CTD) of RfaH adopts an all-alpha fold and is tightly associated with the N-terminal domain (NTD). Upon binding to RNA polymerase (RNAP), the domains dissociate and the CTD transforms into an all-beta fold while the NTD remains largely, but not entirely, unchanged. We test the idea that a change in the conformation of an extended beta-hairpin (beta3-beta4) located on the NTD, helps trigger domain dissociation. To this end, we use homology modeling to construct a structure, H(1), which is similar to free RfaH but with a remodeled beta3-beta4 hairpin. We then use an all-atom physics-based model enhanced with a dual basin structure-based potential to simulate domain separation driven by the thermal unfolding of the CTD with NTD in a fixed, folded conformation. We apply our model to both free RfaH and H(1). For H(1) we find, in line with our hypothesis, that the CTD exhibits lower stability and the domains dissociate at a lower temperature T, as compared to free RfaH. We do not, however, observe complete refolding to the all-beta state in these simulations, suggesting that a change in beta3-beta4 orientation aids in, but is not sufficient for, domain dissociation. In addition, we study the reverse fold switch in which RfaH returns from a domain-open all-beta state to its domain-closed all-alpha state. We observe a T-dependent transition rate; fold switching is slow at low T, where the CTD tends to be kinetically trapped in its all-beta state, and at high-T, where the all-alpha state becomes unstable. Consequently, our simulations suggest an optimal T at which fold switching is most rapid. At this T, the stabilities of both folds are reduced. Overall, our study suggests that both inter-domain interactions and conformational changes within NTD may be important for the proper functioning of RfaH.
abstract_zh: RfaH是一种双结构域变形蛋白，参与转录调控和翻译起始。为执行其双重功能，RfaH依赖于两个耦合的结构变化：结构域解离和折叠转换。在自由状态下，RfaH的C端结构域（CTD）采用全α折叠，并与N端结构域（NTD）紧密关联。当与RNA聚合酶（RNAP）结合时，结构域解离，CTD转变为全β折叠，而NTD大体上（但并非完全）保持不变。我们检验了一个观点，即位于NTD上的延伸β-发夹（β3-β4）构象变化有助于触发结构域解离。为此，我们使用同源建模构建了一个结构H(1)，该结构与自由RfaH相似，但β3-β4发夹经过重塑。随后，我们使用一个基于全原子物理模型并增强有双盆地结构基势的模型，模拟在NTD固定为折叠构象时由CTD热展开驱动的结构域分离。我们将模型应用于自由RfaH和H(1)。对于H(1)，我们发现，与我们的假设一致，与自由RfaH相比，CTD表现出较低的稳定性，且结构域在较低温度T下解离。然而，我们在这些模拟中未观察到完全重折叠至全β状态，这表明β3-β4取向的变化有助于结构域解离，但不足以单独实现。此外，我们研究了反向折叠转换，即RfaH从结构域开放的全β状态返回到其结构域闭合的全α状态。我们观察到依赖于T的转换速率；在低T下，折叠转换缓慢，此时CTD倾向于动力学上被困在其全β状态，而在高T下，全α状态变得不稳定。因此，我们的模拟提示存在一个最佳T，在此温度下折叠转换最为迅速。在此T下，两种折叠的稳定性均降低。总体而言，我们的研究表明，结构域间相互作用和NTD内的构象变化可能对RfaH的正常功能都至关重要。
